content: .{@-मुख@} {%a.%} [अश्वस्य मुखमिव मुखमस्य] having the head or face of a horse. . ({@-खः@}) a horse-faced creature, a Kinnara or celestial chorister; (according to others) a kind of demigod distinct from the preceding. . ({@-खी@}) a Kinnara woman; भिन्दन्ति मन्दां गतिमश्वमुख्यः <ls>Ku. 1. 11</ls>.
